observation.weakness: Candidate A (Generalist Repair) applies latency, capacity, and routing repairs sequentially using contract-referenced rules, but the development evidence shows that each family has distinct config/contract values requiring separate tool invocations. The single generalist executor cannot simultaneously inspect and apply three different contract sets without redundant inspections, and the current workflow forces re-inspection of already-fixed values, wasting work_units.
observation.lesson: A single generalist worker must inspect_contract for each family's unique contract before applying rules; sharing contract evidence across families is not valid because contract values differ per incident. Candidate B must distribute families to specialist workers to avoid redundant inspections and meet efficiency targets.
